title: fix: reject a non-integer usage limit
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Added integer validation for the `limit` parameter on `/account/usage`, `/account/key/usage`, and `/account/earnings/transactions`. Fractional values such as `limit=1.5` now return a 400 ValidationError instead of reaching Tinybird's `Int32(limit)`; a regression test confirms the rejected request makes no Tinybird call.
